statement: ∀ t u : ℝ, dist (GP.join (0 : GP.Space 0) t) (GP.join (0 : GP.Space 0) u) = dist t u
proof:
intro t u
have hs : dist (GP.join (0 : GP.Space 0) t) (GP.join (0 : GP.Space 0) u) ^ 2 = dist t u ^ 2 := by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq]
  simp [GP.join, Fin.snoc_zero]
nlinarith [dist_nonneg (x := GP.join (0 : GP.Space 0) t) (y := GP.join (0 : GP.Space 0) u), dist_nonneg (x := t) (y := u)]
